records.label: AI GENERATED STRATEGIC ANALYSIS
rules: Do not raise a hero tier solely because the hero received a buff.
Require verified hero data and explicit matchup or synergy evidence before ranking a draft candidate.
Consider team role coverage, known counter evidence, known synergy evidence, and patch freshness.
When evidence is absent or stale, return insufficient-data instead of inventing a recommendation.
Never describe this analysis as an official Moonton recommendation.
